raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: For one upper fragment, count 6 ring bonds including the two dotted C-N bonds, 4 C-methyl substituent bonds, and 1 N-O bond, giving 11 non-H bonds. Since the image has two identical such fragments, count 2 × 11 = 22. Then count the central O-Cl single bond as 1. Total = 22 + 1 = 23.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有左右两个相同的上方有机片段；每个片段包含一个六元环样结构，底部有一个 N，N 与两侧环碳之间用虚线表示相互作用/键，并且 N 向下连着一个 O。每个片段两侧的环碳各连有两个甲基取代基线段。图中央下方有一个 O 与 Cl 的单键；图中的弯箭头按题意忽略。
推理：按指定方法，对一个上方片段计数：6 个环内键，包括两个虚线 C-N 键；4 个 C-甲基取代基键；1 个 N-O 键。因此一个片段有 6 + 4 + 1 = 11 个非氢键。左右两个相同片段共 2 × 11 = 22 个非氢键。再加中央 O-Cl 单键 1 个，总数为 22 + 1 = 23。
